mentions.name: PointWiseSystem
mentions.description: PointWiseSystem is a browser-based habit and responsibility system that uses a simple points model instead of streaks or financial-style tracking to make expectations visible, progress clear, and follow-through easier. It serves as a family chore chart that engages kids with responsibilities using points and rewards, a personal habit tracker for organizing routines, adding notes, and earning points toward self-defined rewards, and a complete homeschool management tool for tracking assignments, logging progress by subject, and generating reports and transcripts for multiple students. It runs entirely on the web with no app download and works on phones, tablets, and desktops.
mentions.problem: Simpler systems get abandoned instead of used; the points model makes expectations visible, progress clear, and follow-through easier for chores, habits, and homeschooling.
mentions.audience: Families with kids handling chores, individuals tracking personal routines, and homeschool families managing multiple students.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building PointWiseSystem, a browser-based habit and responsibility system I originally built for my own family.

It uses a simple points model instead of streaks or financial-style tracking to make expectations visible, progress clear, and follow-through easier.
